newsitem.title: USA: MOTOROLA INC SAYS TO DEPLOY NETWORK IN INDIA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOROLA INC SAYS TO DEPLOY NETWORK IN INDIA.

text.p: Motorola Inc 's cellular infrastructure group said Monday it has been selected by Bharti Telenet Ltd to deploy a digital wireless telephone network in India.
The initial deployment of the project is valued at more than $50 million.
Motorola's cellular infrastruture group will begin deployment of the wireless local loop system this fall. Once commercial service begins, the system will serve the state of Madhya Pradesh in India.
